name: Cozy Safe: Encrypted Vault
subtitle: Photos, notes, passwords, 2FA
promo: Your photos, documents, notes, passwords and two-factor codes, encrypted on your device. No account, no ads, no tracking. Free and open source.
short: Encrypted vault for photos, files, notes, passwords and 2FA codes. No account.
description:
Cozy Safe is a private vault for the things you would not want anyone else to open: photos and videos, documents and files, notes, voice memos, passwords and two-factor codes. Everything is encrypted on your device before it is saved. There is no account and no server of ours: without your password nobody can open your vault, not even us.

WHAT YOU CAN KEEP
• Photos and videos: take them with the app's own camera (they never reach your photo library and carry no location data) or add them from your device.
• Documents and files of any kind, with a PDF viewer inside the app.
• Notes with headings, lists and to-do boxes. Lists and search show titles only.
• Voice memos, encrypted the moment you stop recording.
• Passwords, live two-factor (TOTP) codes and recovery codes.

HOW IT IS PROTECTED
• Each vault opens with your vault password together with a 24-word Recovery Key kept on the device, so a copied file or backup is not enough to guess its way in.
• Unlock with Face ID, Touch ID or fingerprint, or the vault password. Wrong passwords make you wait longer each time.
• The vault locks when you leave the app and after a few minutes without a touch.
• Passwords and the Recovery Key stay hidden until you ask to see them; anything you copy is cleared from the clipboard shortly after.
• Every security setting asks for Face ID, fingerprint or the device passcode first.
• Top Secret Mode: for the most sensitive vault, the app never opens or previews anything inside it, and screenshots are blocked.

SYNC AND BACKUP, STILL ENCRYPTED
• Sync with your other device on the same Wi-Fi, directly between the two.
• Or sync through your own Google Drive: only encrypted files are stored there, and the app can see only the files it made.
• Back up a vault to one encrypted file and restore it on a new device with your Recovery Key and vault password.

NO TRACKING
• No account, no ads, no analytics, no crash reports.
• The app connects to the network only for a sync you turn on.

OPEN SOURCE
The code is public (GPL-3.0) at github.com/cozy-pi/cozysafe, built in the open, so anyone can check what the app does. Also available for Mac, Windows and Linux at safe.cozypi.com.

GOOD TO KNOW
• There is no recovery: if you lose your vault password, or both the device and the Recovery Key, nobody can get your data back. Keep the 24 words somewhere safe.
• The app cannot protect a device that already has malware, and anyone who knows the password can open the vault.
• The code has not yet had an independent security audit.

15 languages. Light and dark.
